stem: A facility compares two canopy plans. The denser plan produces more inflorescence mass per square meter but poorer cannabinoid uniformity within individual plants. What is the best interpretation?
choices: Density creates a tradeoff, so compare yield per area with within-plant uniformity according to the production objective
Prefer the denser plan because increased yield per area should take priority even when product uniformity is a stated target
Prefer the lower-density plan because uniformity should take priority even when maximizing production per area is the stated target
Treat density as an unlikely cause of the difference and evaluate cultivar identity before considering canopy spacing
rationale: Controlled cannabis research has shown that higher planting density can increase yield per area while reducing within-plant cannabinoid uniformity, making the decision dependent on the defined production objective rather than a single metric.
